result: No reproduced new privacy, authorization, semantic or keyset blocker in these two patches. This is not release or hosted-capacity approval.

tests.note: This working-tree run included the later mode-specific guard; it is not presented as an exact 201b25bc run.

Exact requested 201b25bc SQL/rollback/preimage were loaded from Git into read-only in-process fs overrides; the expanded test also covers MAP/PLACES any-time behavior. The tested statement and rollback were not edited.

scopeChecked: Owned bilateral rows precede Agreement grouping; other workers are excluded
Accepted price/currency/people and review-aware lifecycle grouping
Foreign account/view/cursor, equal timestamps, microseconds, abort/retry and A-B-A session fences
Discovery invoker/RLS/ACL preservation and exact guarded rollback
Filter, location-coarseness, count, map, facet and pagination parity

discoverySyntheticObservation.boundary: Isolated PostgreSQL WASM fixtures; no hosted latency or PostGIS capacity inference.

legacyBoundaryProbe.boundary: Actual client pagination/cursor code; synthetic RPC/Auth and final card-enrichment seam. No real network, public-card decoder, hosted RLS or Android verification.

limits: The production legacy walk still refuses more than 5000 open tasks, after 25 pages of 200; it does not silently display a partial list. This is not an account-count limit.
P6 SQL and author batching do not change the production reader flag.
Agreement pages contain 20 complete task groups, not necessarily 20 bilateral Agreements; one large group and owner-wide classification/counts still need capacity measurement.
Unfiltered Discovery PAGE, global map counts and whole bounds still require broad work. Selective price/location prefilters are not complete spatial optimization.
No physical Android, two-device E2E, hosted load or release approval is established by this review.
